notes: V1.0.0.64: optional 30/60/90/120/180-second turn timers, whole-match time limits and round limits for solo and hosted lobbies. Limits default off; most territories wins at the match limit, with shared victories on ties. Faster first-capture interaction through prepared commander reactions and occupation rigs, coalesced native saves and cached battle-history snapshots. Rapid phase controls cannot skip the next human turn. Approved terrain, water, unit detail, animations, portraits, music, maps and wardrobe assets retained.
